description: Implementation of the KernelTimeout class for managing timeouts in synchronization primitives, including conversions between different time representations and platform-specific time functions.

classes.name: KernelTimeout
classes.description: Class managing timeout representations and conversions for synchronization operations.

methods.name: SteadyClockNow
methods.description: Returns current time in nanoseconds using steady clock if supported, otherwise falls back to system clock.

methods.name: KernelTimeout (constructor with absl::Time)
methods.description: Initializes KernelTimeout from an absl::Time object, handling special cases like infinite and past times.

methods.name: KernelTimeout (constructor with absl::Duration)
methods.description: Initializes KernelTimeout from an absl::Duration, normalizing negative and overly large durations.

methods.name: MakeAbsNanos
methods.description: Returns the absolute timeout in nanoseconds, adjusting for relative timeouts.

methods.name: InNanosecondsFromNow
methods.description: Returns the timeout in nanoseconds from the current time.

methods.name: MakeAbsTimespec
methods.description: Converts the absolute timeout to a timespec structure.

methods.name: MakeRelativeTimespec
methods.description: Converts the relative timeout to a timespec structure.

methods.name: MakeClockAbsoluteTimespec
methods.description: Returns an absolute timespec based on a specified clock, platform-specific, if not on Windows.

methods.name: InMillisecondsFromNow
methods.description: Returns the timeout in milliseconds from now, rounding up and handling overflow.

methods.name: ToChronoTimePoint
methods.description: Converts the timeout to a std::chrono::time_point.

methods.name: ToChronoDuration
methods.description: Returns the timeout as a std::chrono::nanoseconds duration.
